'''Supply tunnel 26''' was located under the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] [[Darmas Pollaran]] attempted to blow up the tunnel for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]], but was stopped by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as the [[Voidhound]].
